builds.name: Condemn: impact plus wall collision
builds.summary: Investigate high one Condemn impact and wall-collision bonus output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Condemn impact and wall-collision bonus output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The impact is 50/85/120/155/190 + 0.5 bonus AD physical; terrain collision adds 1.5 times that amount as bonus damage. A successful rank-5 two-packet nominal sum is 475 + 1.25 bonus AD, rather than just 1.5 times the whole event. Wall stun is a separate effect.

ceiling.targetName: one Condemn impact and wall-collision bonus
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 2s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills and active temporary AD buff. Final Hour legally active at its learned rank, with actual added AD recorded. One champion collides with actual terrain after one E inside two seconds. No Tumble attack, Silver Bolts proc or extra basic attack in the selected sum.
